speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To help narrow this down, has this rash appeared in specific patterns like a net-like webbing or raised bumps?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history on a rice farm and with livestock, have you noticed any small, itchy, red bumps on your skin, or any sores inside your mouth or nose?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.
